claims.claim: ASML's High-NA EUV adoption has crossed from development narrative into production evidence: Intel Foundry is using EXE High-NA EUV on selected Intel 18A Panther Lake layers in high-volume manufacturing, with yields reported matched to the NXE platform.

ASML reported Q2 2026 sales of EUR9.3B and said AI-related Logic and Memory demand is translating into customer commitments across its portfolio; management planned roughly 30% more low-NA EUV capacity for 2027 versus about 65 systems in 2026 and was investigating another roughly 30% capacity increase for 2028.

A September 14 Reuters report, citing JPMorgan analysts after a meeting with ASML's CFO, said ASML is examining capacity for more than 110 EUV systems in 2028 and is nearly fully booked for 2027; this is a material demand/capacity signal but remains secondary-source evidence until matched to a newer ASML primary disclosure.

ASML's current US hiring footprint includes manufacturing/supply-chain expansion in Wilton and EUV-source engineering in San Diego, consistent with continued industrialization and support capacity rather than a retreat from advanced lithography investment.

factors.name: Technology bottleneck power
factors.basis: High-NA EUV has reached production use and ASML remains the unique commercial supplier of EUV lithography at the leading edge.

factors.name: AI infrastructure demand linkage
factors.basis: Primary Q2 commentary explicitly connects AI-related Logic/Memory investment to stronger customer commitments and capacity planning.

factors.name: Capacity execution
factors.basis: Planned EUV capacity expansion can monetize demand, but scaling output of extremely complex systems increases supplier and manufacturing execution requirements.

factors.name: Geopolitical/export-control exposure
factors.basis: Advanced lithography sits directly inside strategic technology controls and China self-reliance pressure, creating policy-dependent market-access risk.

risks.risk: EUV/High-NA capacity expansion depends on a specialized supplier network and successful industrialization; demand visibility does not eliminate throughput constraints.
Export-control tightening or customer-country restrictions can reduce addressable demand and increase compliance complexity.
China's accelerated advanced-manufacturing self-reliance is a long-horizon substitution pressure even though no current commercial peer has displaced ASML at leading-edge EUV.

causalEdges.from: AI-driven leading-edge Logic and Memory investment
causalEdges.mechanism: smaller-feature advanced nodes require increasingly capable lithography and more leading-edge wafer capacity
causalEdges.falsifier: customers materially reduce leading-edge capex or adopt process architectures that sharply reduce EUV intensity

causalEdges.mechanism: production yield/throughput evidence reduces customer technology-adoption risk
causalEdges.falsifier: high-volume economics fail to beat multi-patterning alternatives at customer nodes

contradictions.claim: Very strong AI-linked demand and capacity expansion coexist with strategic export-control exposure and active Chinese self-reliance efforts.
contradictions.resolution: These are simultaneous demand and geopolitical facts; policy/substitution risk should remain explicit rather than netted out of the positive demand signal.

unknowns.unknown: The >110 EUV systems for 2028 figure is currently supported here by Reuters/JPMorgan reporting rather than a newer ASML primary filing; exact committed 2028 output remains unknown.
Exact future High-NA unit mix, customer acceptance timing and realized gross-margin contribution remain execution evidence to be observed.

claims.claim: Execution has strengthened the High-NA thesis: Intel has moved selected 18A product layers into high-volume manufacturing using ASML High-NA EUV, providing real production evidence rather than only roadmap commitments.

Q2 2026 performance exceeded ASML guidance on sales and management described first-half order intake as extremely strong, with customer commitments supporting planned EUV capacity expansion through 2028.

The expectation burden is also rising: reported near-full 2027 bookings and exploration of >110 EUV systems in 2028 imply that supplier throughput, customer fab readiness and AI-capex durability must remain strong to convert the narrative into realized economics.

factors.name: Execution versus narrative
factors.basis: High-NA has production evidence and Q2 operating results/order commentary support the demand thesis.

factors.name: Expectation burden
factors.basis: Capacity plans and reported booking strength raise the future delivery/utilization bar.

factors.name: Capital allocation
factors.basis: ASML continues a share-buyback program while investing to expand complex EUV capacity; both require durable cash generation and disciplined execution.

factors.name: Policy sensitivity
factors.basis: Leading-edge lithography is exposed to export controls and strategic industrial policy outside ASML's control.

risks.risk: Security-level valuation attractiveness is not asserted because no canonical live valuation/entry input was part of this work item; this is non-gating.
A higher booked/capacity expectation base increases downside sensitivity to AI-capex normalization, customer fab delays or supplier bottlenecks.
High-NA's approximately $400M system cost raises customer return-on-investment requirements and can affect adoption timing even when technical readiness is strong.

causalEdges.mechanism: matched-yield production use validates manufacturability and integration
causalEdges.falsifier: later customer production data shows unacceptable throughput, uptime or cost per wafer

causalEdges.mechanism: multi-year customer commitments justify supplier and assembly scaling
causalEdges.falsifier: cancellations, pushouts or utilization weakness emerge before expanded capacity is absorbed

contradictions.claim: Technical adoption evidence is strengthening while valuation/expectation risk may also be increasing.
contradictions.resolution: Execution quality and security-level attractiveness are analytically separate; this Scout object promotes no price-based recommendation.

unknowns.unknown: No canonical live valuation or entry recommendation is promoted by this Scout object.
The realized 2028 EUV output, High-NA mix and incremental margins remain future execution evidence.
